name: Agent Role 2 Code
definition: Specifies the role of the agent.

SPAY.name: System Paying Agent
SPAY.definition: The System Paying Agent (SPA) is the party within the CSD that is responsible for the distribution of cash and security proceeds related to a specific distribution to other CSD Parties.

CODO.name: Co Domicile
CODO.definition: Sub-agent appointed to execute the payment for the corporate action event on behalf of the issuer company/offeror.

ISAG.name: Issuer Agent
ISAG.definition: Party appointed to administer the event on behalf of the issuer company/offeror. The party may be contacted for more information about the event.

REGR.name: Registrar
REGR.definition: Party/agent responsible for maintaining the register of a security.

PAYA.name: Paying Agent
PAYA.definition: Agent (principal or fiscal paying agent) appointed to execute the payment for the corporate action event on behalf of the issuer company/offeror.
